title: oldenlandia brachiata

It is native to Southeast Asia and has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties. The health benefits of Oldenlandia brachiata include reducing fever, alleviating respiratory issues, and protecting against oxidative stress.
